tags: sudoku,logic,logic puzzle,number puzzle,puzzle,numbers,brain teaser,thinking,reasoning,4x4,6x6,9x9,picture sudoku,kids sudoku,easy sudoku,hard sudoku,notes,math,maths
description: Sudoku for every age, from a tiny 4×4 with pictures to the classic 9×9. Tap a box, then a number: every row, column and box needs each number once. Eight levels from Tiny Easy to Classic Expert, with notes, undo, hints and a mistake check, and every puzzle has exactly one answer. An unfinished puzzle waits for you when you come back.
notes: Built on the Oomba Kit (the pinned kit 1.1.5 tag plus the dress and art-school packs): Oomba.game with controls 'none' and a fixed camera in the meadow theme, the kit's title (a little 4x4 puzzle as the badge), how-to cards, pause screen (P, Esc or the pause button: it blurs the board and stops the clock), settings, results card with stars and points (w.win, which calls BRB.gameOver and submits the score), sounds, font and light/dark look. The level picker, the board, the pad and the tools are the game's own DOM inside Oomba.ui.root(), colored with kit roles through CSS variables (no color codes). Levels (SudokuCore.LEVELS): Tiny 4x4 Easy (10-11 givens) and Medium (7-8), with an optional picture mode (the kit's apple, banana, grapes and carrot instead of 1-4) for children who are not reading numbers yet; Small 6x6 (2x3 boxes) Easy (20-22) and Medium (13-15); Classic 9x9 Easy (38-42), Medium (32-36), Hard (28-31) and Expert (23-27). The puzzle maker is window.SudokuCore (pure functions between /* sudoku-core:begin */ and /* sudoku-core:end */, unit-tested): a seeded mulberry32 random, a full board by backtracking, then digits taken away (in matching pairs on the 9x9 below Expert) only while a solver that counts up to two solutions still finds exactly one. Each try is graded by a human-style solver (naked singles; hidden singles; pointing, claiming, naked and hidden pairs; naked and hidden triples, X-wing and XY-wing) and kept only when its givens and its hardest step fit the level: Tiny and Small Easy need nothing past naked singles, Small Medium needs hidden singles, Classic Medium needs more than naked singles, Hard needs pairs or pointing, and Expert needs triples, an X-wing or an XY-wing. Bounded by tries, never by the clock, so a seed makes the same puzzle on every device (usually well under 100 ms, Expert under half a second on a laptop); a short 'Making your puzzle' card shows first. Play: tap a box, then a number (keys 1-9, arrows, Backspace or Delete, N for notes, Z or U to undo, H for a hint); pencil notes (a placed number leaves the notes of the boxes that see it), undo, erase, hints (fill one right box, counted, locked), a check toggle (wrong numbers get a ✕ and a strike) and clashes always shown with a '!' badge as well as color; the chosen box's row, column and box and the same number are highlighted. The board is always left to right (digits stay 1-9) while the words mirror in Arabic and Hebrew; every box is a button with a label ('Row 3, column 5, 7', 'empty', notes, given, hint, clash), and the win is announced. Phone first: the board stays square and as big as the screen allows, with the pad under it in portrait and beside it in landscape. Stars: 3 with no hints, no mistakes and inside the level's par time, one off for any help, one more for four or more, one for going over time. Saved in BRB.storage key 'sudoku-v1': the picture and check settings, the unfinished puzzle of each level (its digits as text, notes, hints, mistakes, time) so a reload continues from 'Continue', and the best stars per level. All words in 13 languages (the I18N block). window.__brbTest: state, pick(level, {seed}), picker, select, press, erase, undo, hint, notes, checkMistakes, pictures, fill(leave), jot, skipAnimations, setTime, core.

es.title: Sudoku
es.description: Sudoku para todas las edades, desde un mini 4×4 con dibujos hasta el clásico 9×9. Toca una casilla y luego un número: cada fila, columna y caja necesita cada número una vez. Ocho niveles, de Mini Fácil a Clásico Experto, con notas, deshacer, pistas y revisión de errores, y cada sudoku tiene una sola solución. Un sudoku a medias te espera cuando vuelvas.

fr.title: Sudoku
fr.description: Du sudoku pour tous les âges, d’un mini 4×4 avec des images au classique 9×9. Touche une case, puis un chiffre : chaque ligne, colonne et carré doit avoir chaque chiffre une fois. de.title: Sudoku
de.description: Sudoku für jedes Alter, vom Mini-4×4 mit Bildern bis zum klassischen 9×9. Tippe auf ein Feld und dann auf eine Zahl: In jeder Reihe, Spalte und jedem Kästchen steht jede Zahl genau einmal. Acht Stufen von Mini Leicht bis Klassisch Profi, mit Notizen, Zurück, Tipps und Fehlerprüfung, und jedes Rätsel hat genau eine Lösung. Ein angefangenes Rätsel wartet auf dich, wenn du wiederkommst.

nl.title: Sudoku
nl.description: Sudoku voor elke leeftijd, van een mini 4×4 met plaatjes tot de klassieke 9×9. Tik op een vakje en dan op een getal: in elke rij, kolom en elk blok staat elk getal één keer. Acht niveaus van Mini Makkelijk tot Klassiek Expert, met notities, terugzetten, hints en een foutencontrole, en elke puzzel heeft precies één oplossing. Een puzzel die nog niet af is, wacht op je als je terugkomt.

ru.title: Судоку
ru.description: Судоку для любого возраста: от мини 4×4 с картинками до классического 9×9. Нажми на клетку, а потом на число: в каждой строке, столбце и квадрате каждое число стоит один раз. Восемь уровней от «Мини, легко» до «Классика, эксперт», с заметками, отменой, подсказками и проверкой ошибок, и у каждой задачи ровно одно решение. Незаконченное судоку дождётся тебя, когда ты вернёшься.

ja.title: すうどく
ja.description: イラストでできるミニ4×4から、クラシックな9×9まで、だれでもあそべるすうどく。マスをタップして数字をタップ。たて、よこ、ブロックには、どの数字も1回ずつ入ります。ミニ かんたんからクラシック エキスパートまで8つのレベル。メモ、もどす、ヒント、まちがいチェックつきで、どのパズルも答えはひとつだけ。とちゅうのパズルは、またあそびにきたときにつづきからできます。

zh-Hant.title: 數獨
zh-Hant.description: 適合每個年紀的數獨，從有圖案的迷你 4×4 到經典的 9×9。點一個格子，再點一個數字：每一橫排、直行和宮裡，每個數字都只出現一次。從迷你簡單到經典專家共八個關卡，有筆記、復原、提示和檢查錯誤，而且每道題目都只有一個答案。還沒解完的題目，下次回來還在等你。

ar.title: سودوكو
ar.description: سودوكو لكل الأعمار، من لغز صغير جدًا 4×4 بالصور إلى سودوكو 9×9 الكلاسيكي. المس خانة، ثم المس رقمًا: في كل صف وعمود ومربع يأتي كل رقم مرة واحدة. ثمانية مستويات من صغير جدًا سهل إلى كلاسيكي خبير، مع ملاحظات وتراجع وتلميحات والتحقق من الأخطاء، ولكل لغز حل واحد فقط. اللغز الذي لم يكتمل ينتظرك عندما تعود.

he.title: סודוקו
he.description: סודוקו לכל גיל, מ־4×4 זעיר עם תמונות ועד 9×9 הקלאסי. הקישו על משבצת ואז על מספר: בכל שורה, עמודה וריבוע כל מספר מופיע פעם אחת. שמונה שלבים, מזעיר קל ועד קלאסי מומחה, עם הערות, ביטול, רמזים ובדיקת טעויות, ולכל חידה יש פתרון אחד בלבד. חידה שלא נגמרה מחכה לכם כשתחזרו.
